episodes.final_message: I haven't seen your recent sleep or stress check-ins pop up, and I know you have a busy midterm schedule today. How are your energy and stress levels feeling this evening?

Midterm week with back-to-back deadlines can feel so overwhelming, especially when you're feeling isolated or carrying a heavy load by yourself. Please know you don't have to handle this alone—Dick's House Counseling ((603) 646-9442) offers warm, confidential support and after-hours care, and you can also reach out to the 988 Lifeline (call/text 988) anytime 24/7. For tonight, please give yourself permission to pause, take a deep breath, and rest.

Navigating three deadlines today while managing 'a blizzard of emotions' can feel so exhausting, and it is completely valid that your stress is hitting a peak tonight. Please remember you don't have to carry this heavy load all by yourself—Dick's House Counseling ((603) 646-9442) offers warm, confidential support, and the 988 Lifeline (call/text 988) is available 24/7. For this evening, give yourself permission to step back from the screens, take a few slow breaths, and focus on getting some restful sleep.
